svg.title: Grafana Play Home dashboard: five monitoring panels
svg.desc: A dark Grafana dashboard screenshot recreated as vector art. A left icon rail and a top bar reading "Grafana Play Home" with a "Last 1 hour" time picker sit above five panels: "server requests" (four stacked blue web_server areas, 0-150), "Memory / CPU" (a light-blue memory area with point markers against a left 0-10 B axis plus an orange cpu line against a right 0-15% axis), "client side full page load" (stacked yellow/orange/red latency bars up to about 4.5 s with an avg legend table), "logins" (blue current logins around 25 and a red logins minus one hour series around 55, both dropping sharply near 21:10), and "Traffic In/Out" (green upper_25 to upper_95 areas above zero and blue cpu1/cpu2 areas below, with an avg and current legend table).
